'''''Vlaso’s Guides to the Galaxy''''' was a kind of insider's guide that helped seasoned travelers steer clear of obvious tourist traps and locate authentic local establishments. It had outlined the best [[Cafe/Legends|cafés]], [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurants]], short‑term lodgings, and money‑saving tips, while discreetly pointing readers toward less publicized places to obtain illicit goods when needed.<ref name="Desperate Allies" />
